title: Read the Modbus TCP register map
summary: Use the version 3.2 register map with explicit word order, data types, scaling, and read-only boundaries.

sections.title: Register conventions
paragraphs: Documentation addresses are one-based while protocol data addresses are zero-based. Multi-register floating-point values use big-endian bytes with the high word first.
sections.code:
40001  AI0_VALUE   float32  read-only  engineering units
40003  AI0_QUALITY uint16   read-only  0=good, 1=stale, 2=fault
